睁.def: to open one's eyes; to stare

origin.says: Simplified from 睜: 目 (eye) for the meaning plus 爭 (strive, shortened to 争) as the sound: to open the eyes wide.

睁.name: open eyes

origin.says: 衤 (clothing) for the meaning plus 彡 (hair strokes) as the sound: an unlined garment, a shirt.
耳 (ear) for the meaning plus 冘 (an old character) as the sound; the first sense was large hanging ears, and the senses 'to indulge' and 'to delay' are later uses of the word.
origin.src: Wiktionary; Dong Chinese; own knowledge for the ear sense

霸.def: tyrant; to usurp, to rule by might

origin.says: One reading: 革 (hide) and 月 (moon) for the moon's changing light; 雨 (rain) was added later for the sound. The word was borrowed for 'overlord, to rule by force'.

霸.name: tyrant

ety.hint: An old 古 tree 木; 古 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 木 (tree) for the meaning plus 古 (ancient) as the sound: a tree dried out, withered.
木 (tree) for the meaning plus 卯 (mortise; 4th branch) as the sound: the willow. Seal script used another sound part 丣, but the modern form returned to 卯.
月 (flesh) for the meaning plus 干 (shield) as the sound: the liver.

ety.hint: A man from a good 良 place 阝;  良 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 良 (good) as the sound, its last stroke dropped, plus 阝 (town, from 邑): first a place name, then borrowed for 'young man, husband'.
口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 龙 (dragon) as the sound: the throat. Simplified from 嚨, with 龍 written 龙.
弓 (bow) for the meaning plus 玄 (cord, dark) as the sound and hint: the string of a bow, then the string of an instrument.
羽 (feathers) for the meaning plus 支 (branch, limb) as the sound: a wing; also fins.

烫.def: to scald; to iron clothes or hair

origin.says: Simplified from 燙: 火 (fire) for the meaning plus 湯 (hot water) as the sound and hint: scalding hot. It uses the simplified 汤 (soup).

烫.name: scald

衅.def: to quarrel, to dispute; a blood sacrifice

origin.says: The full form 釁 drew a blood rite: smearing a vessel with sacrificial blood. 衅 is an old popular variant, 血 (blood) for the meaning with 半 (half) standing in as the sound; from the rite came 'rift, quarrel'.
origin.src: Dong Chinese; MakeMeAHanzi; own knowledge for 釁

衅.name: provoke

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 侯 (marquis) as the sound: the throat behind the mouth.
石 (stone) for the meaning plus 录 (a form of 彔) as the sound: first rough, stony; now mostly busy toil (busy) or mediocre.
言 (speech) for the meaning plus 辟 (law) as the sound: speaking by comparison, an example or metaphor.
From 龜, a picture of a turtle seen from the side and above: head, shell and feet. The simplified form keeps the head and a simplified shell.
Simplified from 屢: 尸 (body) for the meaning plus 婁 (Lou) as the sound, written 娄: again and again.
亻 (person) for the meaning plus 夋 (a walking figure) as the sound: an outstanding person, talented and handsome.
Probably first a large bell: a short form of 庚 (a musical instrument) plus 用 or 同 as the sound. The meaning 'ordinary, common' is later; the top and 用 now share strokes.
口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 八 (eight) as the sound: a mouth-blown horn, a trumpet; also used for sounds.
木 (tree) for the meaning plus 登 (climb) as the sound: the orange tree and its fruit, then the colour orange.
广 (building) for the meaning plus 兼 (both) as the sound. It first meant the sharp edge or corner of a hall; something straight-edged became 'upright, honest' and also 'cheap'.
origin.src: Wiktionary; own knowledge for the first meaning

origin.says: Simplified from 侖: a lid-like top (gather) over 冊 (book, bound slips): books put in order, hence order. The simplified form replaces 冊 with 匕, so the build no longer shows.
Simplified from 驢: 馬 (horse) for the meaning plus 盧 (rice vessel) as the sound; the horse became 马 and the sound part was replaced by 户 (door): donkey.
纟 (silk) for the meaning plus 申 (extend) as the sound: the long sash of formal dress, hence the gentry who wore it. Simplified from 紳, 糹 shortened to 纟.

ety.hint: A ship's 舟 cabin 仓; 仓 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 舟 (boat) for the meaning plus 仓 (granary, storehouse) as sound and meaning: the storage space of a ship, its hold or cabin. Simplified from 艙 by writing 倉 as 仓.
利 (profit) as the sound plus 木 (tree) for the meaning: the pear tree and its fruit.

揉.def: to massage, to knead; to crush by hand

ety.hint: A gentle 柔 hand 扌; 柔 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 柔 (soft) as the sound, which also hints at the sense: working something soft with the hands, to knead.

揉.name: knead

origin.says: 酉 (wine jar) for the meaning plus 孝 (filial) as the sound: fermenting in a jar, yeast.
Stands for 櫃: 木 (wood) plus 匱 (box) as the sound, a wooden cupboard. The simplified form took over 柜, an existing character of 木 (wood) plus 巨 (huge) that named a tree.

妄.def: absurd, foolish, ignorant; rash, reckless, wild

origin.says: 亡 (perish) as the sound plus 女 (woman) for the meaning: wild, reckless, absurd.

妄.name: wild

ety.hint: A mountain 山 range surrounded by hills 丘

origin.says: A mountain 山 (mountain) under a top part that now looks like 丘 (hill); one reading takes the top as a sound loan, origin unclear: a high mountain peak.
⺖ (heart) for the meaning plus 肖 as the sound: first worried, now quiet, silent.
氵 (water) for the meaning plus 肴 (meat dish) as the sound: waters mixed together, confused.

傍.def: beside, close, nearby; to depend on

ety.hint: Someone 亻 by your side 旁; 旁 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 旁 (beside) as the sound: to be close beside someone, to depend on; also 'towards evening'.

傍.name: close by

浮.def: to drift, to float; mobile, temporary, unstable; reckless

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 孚 (to brood) as the sound: to float on water, drifting.

浮.name: bob

歇.def: to stop, to rest, to lodge

origin.says: 欠 (open-mouthed person, breath) for the meaning plus 曷 (why) as the sound: to stop for breath, to rest.

歇.name: take a break

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 召 (to summon) as the sound: a body of standing water, a pond or swamp.

ety.hint: A man 大 armed with a bow 弓

origin.says: Origin unclear: later forms read as 大 (person) with 弓 (bow) wound around, a bowman; one reading sees an arrow tied with cord. Used for the peoples east of the old Chinese states.
火 (fire) for the meaning plus 山 (mountain) as the sound: bright and brilliant. Simplified from 燦, whose long sound part 粲 was replaced by 山.

剖.def: to bisect, to dissect, to slice

origin.says: 咅 (spit) as the sound plus 刂 (knife) for the meaning: cutting something in two, 'to dissect'.

剖.name: dissect

竣.def: to terminate, to finish, to end; to quit

origin.says: 立 (stand) for the meaning plus 夋 (a walking figure) as the sound: to stand still, stop, and so to finish a work.

竣.name: completed

纬.def: warp and woof; lines of latitude

origin.says: Simplified from 緯: 纟 (thread) for the meaning plus 韦 as the sound: the weft threads of weaving, which run across; hence lines of latitude.

纬.name: latitude

缉.def: to sieze, to arrest; to stich closely

origin.says: Simplified from 緝: 纟 (silk thread) for the meaning plus 咠 (whisper) as the sound: stitching close together, later also to seize. The silk side 糹 became 纟.

缉.name: close stitch

origin.says: 木 (wood) for the meaning plus 丙 (third stem) as the sound: a wooden handle; from that, power held in hand.

刹.def: temple, shrine, monastary; an instant, a moment; to brake

origin.says: 杀 (kill) as the sound plus 刂 (knife): used to write Sanskrit words, a temple and an instant; also to brake. Simplified from 剎.

刹.name: brake

仆.def: to fall forward; prostrate, prone; servant

origin.says: An old character 亻 (person) plus 卜 (divine) as the sound, 'to fall forward'. Simplification also took it over for 僕 (servant), once a picture of a slave carrying a basket.

仆.name: fall flat

ety.hint: A wooden 木 lever 工; 工 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 木 (wood) for the meaning plus 工 (work) as the sound: a wooden pole or bar, a lever.
Simplified from 螞: 虫 (insect) for the meaning plus 馬 (horse, shortened to 马) as the sound: small creatures such as ants and leeches.

ety.hint: A deer with an antlered head, two legs, and a tail

origin.says: A picture of a deer: antlers and head on top (now like 广, shelter), the body in the middle and the bent legs below (now like 比, compare).
⺖ (heart) for the meaning plus 易 (easy) as the sound: a wary heart, alert and cautious.

溯.def: to paddle upstream, to go against the current; to trace the source; formerly

ety.hint: To seek the source 朔 of a river 氵

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 朔 (new moon, a return) as the sound: to go back up the stream, to trace to the source.

溯.name: upstream

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 黑 (black) as the sound: first kept silent, now mostly the exclamation 'hey'.
From 綉, a popular form of 繡: 糸 (silk) for the meaning plus 秀 (bloom) as the sound, replacing the harder sound part 肅; 糸 shortened to 纟. To embroider.
木 (tree) for the meaning plus 支 (branch) as sound and meaning: a branch of a tree; at first the same word as 支.
木 (wood) for the meaning plus 冘 (an old character) as the sound: early pillows were blocks of wood.
大 (big) for the meaning plus 者 as the sound: living too big, extravagant.
犭 (dog, animal) for the meaning plus 瓜 (melon) as the sound: the fox.

ety.hint: Simplified form of 薑; grass 艹 provides the meaning while 畺 provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 羊 (sheep) as the sound over 女 (woman) for the meaning: an old clan name. Ginger, 薑 (grass plus a sound part), was merged into it in the simplification.
亻 (person) for the meaning plus 尚 (esteem) as the sound, borrowed for the word 'if, supposing'.
犭 (dog, animal) for the meaning plus 里 (village) as the sound: a wild cat or raccoon-dog type animal; first a variant of 貍.
As a component it draws remains of bones from a carcass, hence death. One reading says the word 'bad' (dǎi) came later and its shape was a borrowed letter; sources disagree.

歹.name: bad bones
歹.in: 死列例烈殊残裂殖葬毙殃殉歼咧

origin.says: Simplified from 癮: 疒 (sickness) for the meaning plus 隱 (hidden) as the sound, first a rash, now an addiction or craving. Both parts are simplified as in 隐.
氵 (water) for the meaning plus 奚 (servant) as the sound: a brook, a mountain stream.
Originally 涼: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 京 (capital) as the sound, cool water. The modern form uses the variant with 冫 (ice) instead of water: cool, cold.

ety.hint: A mountain 山 precipice 厓; 厓 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 山 (mountain) for the meaning plus 厓 (cliff, 厂 cliff + 圭 jade tablet as the sound) as sound and meaning: a cliff, a precipice.

逢.def: to happen to meet; chance meeting, coincidence

origin.says: 辶 (walking) for the meaning plus 夆 (a foot meeting something) as the sound: to meet someone on the road by chance.

逢.name: chance meeting

衔.def: rank, title; to bite, to hold in the mouth

origin.says: Traditional 銜: 行 (road, going) for the meaning plus 金 (metal) as the sound, or the metal bit in a horse's mouth on the road: to hold in the mouth; later a rank. 金 is shortened to 钅.

衔.name: horse bit

origin.says: 土 (earth) for the meaning plus 虚 (hollow) as the sound: a mound, the ruins of an old site.

嗽.def: to gargle; to cough; to clear the throat

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 欶 (to suck) as the sound: to cough, to clear the throat.

嗽.name: throat clear

origin.says: An old character 木 (tree) plus 卜 (divine) as the sound, the name of a tree. Simplification took it over for 樸 (uncut wood), so 'plain, simple'; also a surname.
Simplified from 襪: 衣 (clothing) plus 蔑 (to slight) as the sound. The simplified form keeps 衤 (clothing) and puts the simpler 末 (tip) as the sound: socks, stockings.
虫 (creature) for the meaning plus 圭 (jade tablet) as the sound, perhaps imitating its croak: a frog.
